task: Locate the most recent research paper about 'Algebraic Topology' under Mathematics published on ArXiv. Provide the title of the paper, the name of the authors, and the abstract.
answer: The most recent research paper in Algebraic Topology (math.AT) under Mathematics on arXiv is: Title: The center is the formal internal automorphism group Authors: Sonja Farr Abstract: We prove that the deformation functor associated to an algebra over a sufficiently nice Koszul operad can be lifted to an operadic formal moduli problem over the Koszul dual operad. We further show that this operadic formal moduli problem corresponds to the derived center of the algebra under the operadic Lurie-Pridham correspondence. As an application, we prove that the classical Gerstenhaber algebra structure on polyvector fields of a commutative algebra agrees with the derived center of the algebra as an abelian Poisson algebra. (arXiv:2610.31411, listed first under the most recent date section on https://arxiv.org/list/math.AT/recent; abstract page https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31411)
